answer: A Registered domain bound by attestation certificate with a ninety-day rotation cooldown turns a private channel into public evidence: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a umber only after its channel answers the challenge. A spiral alone is noise; a jetty of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
